summary: Implemented prepareUpdate per the spec, following the prepareQuery pattern. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class holding the translated algebra list; (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) which sets _original_args, and SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update now unwraps Update objects to their algebra; (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate; (4) test/test_sparql_prepare_update.py is a new test file with five tests. Not run: per instructions I did not execute tests, so verification was by reading only. Not committed. Open point: Graph.update passes objects straight to stores, so string-only stores will still reject an Update; I did not add conversion there. Choices made: Update holds only the algebra list because each operation carries its own prologue; tests live in a new file rather than test_sparql.py.
